facts.text: Tim mentions that books help him take himself to other places and he enjoys both fantasy and personal development genres.

evidence.quote: Yes, they are still my favorites - I love how they take me to other places.
I love getting lost in fantasy stories, but also discovering new ways to better myself through books on growth, psychology, and improving myself.

facts.text: John expresses an interest in non-fiction books about personal development and mindset, which he believes help him understand himself better.

evidence.quote: I love non-fiction books about personal development and mindset. They help me know myself better.

facts.text: Tim recently read a book that made a significant impact on him, focusing on how small changes can lead to major differences in his life.

evidence.quote: I recently read a book that really made a big impact on me. It's all about how small changes can make big differences.

facts.text: John recently finished rereading 'The Alchemist' and found it inspiring, which made him feel motivated and hopeful about pursuing his personal legend.

evidence.quote: I recently finished rereading 'The Alchemist' - it was really inspiring. It made me think again about following dreams and searching for our own personal legends. I felt really motivated and hopeful after reading it.
